title: Children at Backyard Birthday Party Table, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A group of children sits gathered around an outdoor party table in a sunny suburban backyard during a celebration, likely a birthday party. Several children wear patterned short-sleeve collared shirts, tiny paper party hats balanced on their heads, and blow noisemakers. A large glass pitcher of punch sits in the center of the white tablecloth alongside cups. In the background, a rotary umbrella clothesline stands on the lawn beside a mid-century residential house adorned with party decorations hanging from a tree, evoking classic postwar American family life.
